props.survey: Radial crowns visible beside Dragonfly Bridge were marked on the OneMap image at zoom 20. Diameter follows the frond spread. Height and species are approximate. Palm proxies use four 0 A.D. royal palm variants. Centres inside the mapped lake were excluded.
